title: Merchant Disputes: Points of Judgement for the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
**Disputes manual, Pocketwire Visa Debit Card: merchant disputes.** A merchant dispute covers a purchase the customer made where one of the following is true:

- the goods were not received;
- the goods were not as described;
- the customer was charged twice;
- the customer was charged the wrong amount;
- a recurring charge continued after it was cancelled;
- a credit the merchant promised never posted.

### Rules in force

1. **Merchant window.** The dispute is accepted only within the merchant window: it must be filed no later than the tier's merchant dispute window, in calendar days, after the card transaction date. The window is counted in calendar days from the transaction date. The day after the transaction is day 1, and a dispute filed on the last day is accepted. The transaction date is taken from the purchase's own record.
2. **No liability, no provisional credit.** Merchant disputes carry no customer liability and no provisional credit.
3. **One dispute per transaction.** The rule that a transaction carries only one dispute applies to merchant disputes too. No merchant dispute is filed on a purchase that already has a dispute for any reason.
4. **Documents and outcome.** The customer uploads supporting documents within the tier's documentation period, in calendar days, after filing. The disputes team records the outcome as approved or denied. A dispute that still has no documents when that period ends is denied.

### Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses are **no longer in force**. Each has been superseded by the current basis:

- "For goods not received, not as described and credit not processed, the customer must first have contacted the merchant at least the tier's merchant-resolution wait in calendar days before filing," a requirement that rested on the customer's statement of the date of first contact. No longer in force.
- "Duplicate charges and incorrect amounts need no merchant contact." No longer in force.
- "The small-dispute auto-credit of the unauthorized dispute rules applies to merchant disputes as well." No longer in force.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical)

| Situation | Judgement |
|---|---|
| Purchase dated 120 days before the filing day | within the window, because the last day is accepted |
| Purchase dated 121 days before the filing day | outside the window |
| The customer made the purchase and was charged twice | a merchant dispute reason |
| The customer did not make the purchase at all | not a merchant dispute, because the purchase was not made by the customer |
| An unauthorized dispute already exists on the purchase | no merchant dispute is filed on it |
| No documents uploaded by the end of the documentation period | the dispute is denied |

superseded_clauses: For goods not received, not as described and credit not processed, the customer must first have contacted the merchant at least merchant_resolution_wait_days calendar days before filing
duplicate charges and incorrect amounts need no merchant contact
the small-dispute auto-credit of card_disputes_unauthorized applies to them as well
